name: B10-0576/2025 (S&D) – Arbitrary arrest and sentencing of academics Bahruz Samadov and Igbal Abilov in Azerbaijan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary arrest and sentencing of academics Bahruz Samadov and Igbal Abilov in Azerbaijan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of two academics jailed in Azerbaijan. It says researcher Bahruz Samadov was given 15 years and historian Igbal Abilov 18 years on charges the Parliament calls baseless. It asks Azerbaijan to respect human rights and asks the European Union to sanction officials responsible, including prosecutors, judges and security officers. It also says any partnership deal with Azerbaijan, including on energy, must depend on respect for fundamental rights.

- The Parliament demands freedom for Samadov, Abilov and other political prisoners; nothing changes on the ground yet.
- It targets Azerbaijani prosecutors, judges and security officials with proposed European Union sanctions.
- It asks the European Commission to suspend the 2022 energy partnership memorandum with Azerbaijan.
